warnings.warning: The objective weights, normalization, sign convention for shipping volume, candidate scores, and sensitivity are absent, so the selected type cannot be replayed.
113.99 km divided by 91 cells is about 1.2526 km per cell, not the printed 1.281 km per cell; every transformed distance needs recomputation.
The printed S relation is a sum of squared coordinate differences without a square root, conflicting with its earlier use as distance and leaving the half-range constraint dimensionally ambiguous.
The floor-plus-one rule can remove an extra layer when the required clearance is an exact multiple and has no max-with-zero guard when residual space already suffices.
Equations (9)-(12) use alternative divisors and residual dimensions without a complete orientation rule, coordinate placement, or collision proof.
Multiplying three one-axis removal counts does not prove that exactly that many occupied cuboids must be removed or that the UAV can be inserted without collision.
The index structure is ambiguous and summed dimensions are not a complete three-dimensional packing or centre-of-gravity formulation.
The report does not define how selected TG points represent all required road segments, so a shortest node tour need not maximize useful or unique road reconnaissance.
The prose uses tau_k for the visited-node record even though tau denotes pheromone elsewhere, and the admissible-set notation and normalization are not made implementation-stable.
The update timing t+N, evaporation semantics, parameters, initial pheromone, cycle budget, seed, repeated runs, convergence trace, runtime, and exact comparator are unreported.

disaster stakes, six prompt deliverables, packing literature, assumptions, notation, and objective priorities
hospital isolation, shared-service screening, drone-type selection, and two candidate container schemes
ODMU package-first fill, UAV-later removal, and two quantified packing tables
road gridding, scale, hospital mapping, coverage-constrained site search, and scheme choice

main_argument_chains.claim: A reusable, low-count fleet can be screened from hospital geography, demand, payload, range, and container-space priorities.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Pass both candidate fleets to ISO packing and site feasibility while preserving their unresolved letter conflicts.

main_argument_chains.claim: Package-first and UAV-later arithmetic can turn each candidate fleet into an understandable container-loading plan.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the layouts as constructive candidates, not certified three-dimensional optima or complete hospital-support ledgers.
support_steps: remove packages for two UAV orientations

main_argument_chains.claim: A common road grid can join hospital delivery reach with road-reconnaissance coverage during container siting.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Select three scheme-1 sites only after correcting scale, distance semantics, candidate-domain, and circular-coverage replay gaps.
support_steps: threshold and coarsen the road raster
count TG cells in half-range regions

main_argument_chains.claim: Cargo-bay packing can connect support days to delivery frequency and leave time for road reconnaissance.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Pass hospital-specific bundles to routing and scheduling after a full three-dimensional mass and balance replay.
support_steps: report B, C, and D layouts

main_argument_chains.claim: Obstacle-aware delivery can be organized by a Voronoi candidate skeleton followed by Dijkstra paths and endpoint adjustment.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the paths as internal route candidates pending frozen obstacle geometry, graph, connectors, clearance, and code.

main_argument_chains.claim: Closed-tour reconnaissance and ACO can turn nearby TG nodes into six route candidates and one combined operating calendar.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat route and schedule outputs as stochastic internal results until node coverage, closure, parameters, seeds, and resources are replayed.

main_argument_chains.claim: The final distance table establishes only a narrow route-length check, not overall system validation.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Keep HELP recommendations conditional on corrected units, payload-energy calibration, resource-feasible schedules, uncertainty, and external outcomes.
